name: streamlit-genai-chatbot
description: Generative AI chatbot built with Streamlit, LangChain, and Groq. Chat in your browser with conversation memory powered by Llama 3.3.

name: twitter-clone
description: 🐦 A full-stack Twitter clone built with the MERN stack, featuring authentication, social interactions, and cloud-based media handling.

name: Product-store
description: 🛒 MERN stack product store — built for personal full-stack learning. Create, update & delete products with Chakra UI v3, Zustand, and dark mode. Live at https://product-store-qzbn.onrender.com/

name: Camera-Pose-Estimation-Project
description: AI project on camera pose estimation using deep learning and synthetic 3D-rendered data. Built a CNN trained on thousands of generated images to predict camera orientation. Achieved 97% validation accuracy with optimized dataset sampling. Applications in AR/VR, robotics, and 3D reconstruction.

name: Operating-Systems---BGU
description: Projects for the Operating Systems course at BGU, based on the xv6-riscv teaching OS. Includes implementing system calls, process management, scheduling, synchronization (Peterson locks, tournament tree), virtual memory, shared memory, and a multi-process logging system in C.

name: System-Programming-SPL-Projects-BGU
description: Projects for the System Programming course at BGU. Hands-on C++ and Java assignments covering runtime environments (Unix, JVM), concurrency, memory management, OOP, and sockets. From server-client communication to game logic and system design, each project emphasizes practical application and efficient programming practices.
